jsonld.name: AI SEO
jsonld.description: AI SEO for D2C, B2B and education brands: a single plan for visibility in classic search results and in AI-generated answers.

acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO is a single programme that keeps your brand visible in classic search results and in AI-generated answers from Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. It combines technical SEO, answer-first content, structured data and consistent mentions across the web.

mainEntity.name: How is AI SEO different from SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO is the foundation: crawlability, speed, content and authority. AI SEO adds the work specific to answer engines, such as direct answers, FAQ structure, entity consistency and tracking how you appear in generated answers.

mainEntity.name: How is AI SEO different from AEO and GEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO is the overall plan. AEO focuses on becoming the short answer in snippets, voice and answer boxes. GEO focuses on being cited by generative AI tools. We scope them together so the work is not duplicated.

mainEntity.name: Can you guarantee a mention in ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Nobody outside an AI or search company can promise a citation, a ranking or a position in an answer, and the systems change often. We commit to the work in the monthly scope and to reporting what we can observe.

A monthly scope, agreed after a call and written down so you can see what each month covers. We do not publish a price list because the right scope depends on your site, your market and how much you want done.

Brands whose buyers research before they buy. We do this for D2C, B2B and education brands and set it up differently for each: D2C on products and repeat purchase, B2B on specifications and enquiries, education on courses and admissions.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Access to your site, Search Console and Analytics, your product or course list, the questions your sales or support team hear most, and someone who can approve content. If you are mid-redesign, tell us first.

hub.sub: Buyers now get answers from search results, AI Overviews and assistants. We plan one SEO programme that keeps you visible in all of them.

answer.label: In short
answer.lead: AI SEO is the work of keeping your brand visible and accurately described wherever buyers now look for answers: classic search results, Google AI Overviews and assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini. It joins technical SEO, clear content and trusted mentions into one plan.
answer.who: Monday Marketing Company (MMC) runs AI SEO for D2C, B2B and education brands, as the umbrella over our answer-engine and generative-engine work.

answer.chip: Visible in search and in AI answers

paras: A buyer who used to scroll ten blue links may now read a generated summary, ask an assistant a follow-up and only then visit a site. Some of those answers name brands and link to sources; many do not send a click at all.

That makes two things matter more than before: whether your pages are the clear, accurate source an answer can draw from, and whether trusted places beyond your own site describe you the same way. Neither replaces the SEO basics. Both sit on top of them.

leaks.lede: Each stage below is where a brand drops out of the answer, and the AI SEO work that brings it back.

stages.breaks: Assuming you show up because you rank.
stages.why: Ranking in classic results does not guarantee a mention in a generated answer, and assistants can describe a brand wrongly.
stages.does: We ask the questions your buyers ask across search and assistants, record what is said about you and where the gaps are.

stages.k: Make the site readable by machines
stages.breaks: Pages that crawlers and AI systems struggle to parse.
stages.why: Content hidden behind scripts, blocked by robots rules or lacking structure is harder to retrieve and quote.
stages.does: We fix crawling, indexing, speed and structured data, and review what AI crawlers are allowed to read.

stages.breaks: Writing about the brand instead of the buyer's question.
stages.why: Assistants favour pages that state a clear answer near the top and back it with specifics.
stages.does: We rewrite and build pages with a direct answer first, then detail, FAQs and proof. See AEO.

stages.k: Be described the same way everywhere
stages.breaks: Your own site says one thing and the web says another.
stages.why: Generative systems draw on many sources, so conflicting names, descriptions or facts weaken how you are summarised.
stages.does: We align your name, offer and facts across your site, profiles and trusted third-party sources. See GEO.

stages.why: AI answers vary by question, time and user, so one screenshot proves little.
stages.does: We track a fixed set of buyer questions over time, plus qualified traffic, enquiries and orders from search.
